  have h₁ : -a ≤ -c + b := by
    have h₂ : -a ≤ -c + b := by
      -- Use the given hypothesis to derive the desired inequality
      have h₃ : c ≤ a + b := h
      have h₄ : -a ≤ -c + b := by
        -- Use the property of integers to manipulate the inequality
        linarith
      exact h₄
    exact h₂
  
  have h₂ : -c + b = b - c := by
    rw [add_comm]
    <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> simp_all [add_assoc]
    <;> linarith
  
  have h₃ : -a ≤ b - c := by
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    exact h₁
  
  exact h₃
